Manage widgets

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Search-and-Visualize/Log-Visualization](https://docs.bronto.io/Search-and-Visualize/Log-Visualization)
:::

```sh
bronto widgets <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto widgets attach-widgets`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-attach-widgets) | Attach widgets to a widget |
| [`bronto widgets create`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-create) | Create a widget |
| [`bronto widgets delete`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-delete) | Delete a widget |
| [`bronto widgets get`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-get) | Get a widget by ID |
| [`bronto widgets list`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-list) | List widgets |
| [`bronto widgets remove-widget`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-remove-widget) | Remove a widget from a widget |
| [`bronto widgets update`](/reference/commands/widgets/#bronto-widgets-update) | Update a widget |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto widgets attach-widgets

Attach widgets to a widget

```sh
bronto widgets attach-widgets <widget> --widget-ids <id,...> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--widget-ids` |  | strings |  | widget IDs to attach (comma-separated or repeated) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto widgets attach-widgets <widget> --widget-ids <id>,<id>
```

## bronto widgets create

Create a widget

```sh
bronto widgets create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | request body field as key=value; values parse as JSON when possible (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | read the request body from a file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto widgets create -f name=<name>
bronto widgets create --input body.json
```
